schedule_findings.reduction_loop: Five stride stages persist as unpipelined loops; variable inner-k trip-count UNROLL is rejected (HLS214-187).

schedule_findings.LOAD_QUANT_pipeline_scope: Source includes explicit PIPELINE II1 on several load/quant loops; no claim that the entire source lacks pipelining.
schedule_findings.critical_path: amax FP comparison/select chain in Pipeline_VITIS_LOOP_599_27, not simply integer MAC count.
schedule_findings.mac_budget: 4*8*32=1024 logical integer MACs per fully issued group. B1 Q8 work47160754688/(1024*150e6)=0.3070361633s ideal; using32MAC/cycle would instead be9.8251572267s. Neither is measured; actual reduction, issue intervals, memory and FP restore costs remain.
schedule_findings.DSP40_limit: HLS DSP count is a mapped operator estimate and cannot be read as40 MAC/cycle or1024 MAC/cycle; small integer fabric/FP binding and schedule matter.
